text: This report is filed regarding Junaid Ghani, a senior manager at Zenith Pharma (Pvt) Ltd with a declared monthly income of PKR 600,000. Between June 2 and June 25, 2026, the subject made 17 separate cash deposits at the Saddar Branch in Karachi, totaling approximately PKR 13.9 million. This volume is significantly inconsistent with his declared salary and typical business activities. The deposits exhibit a clear structuring pattern, with individual amounts frequently falling just below the PKR 1,000,000 Cash Transaction Report (CTR) threshold (e.g., PKR 990,000 on June 4, PKR 952,000 on June 13, and PKR 541,000 on June 25). Furthermore, the funds were rapidly swept out via Interbank Fund Transfers (IBFT) to two counterparties: Sheraz Traders (PKR 4,793,000 on June 6) and Al-Noor Exchange Company (PKR 2,764,000 on June 11). The use of an exchange company as a recipient, combined with the high-frequency, sub-threshold cash inflows, suggests potential money laundering or hawala activity. The customer’s risk rating is low, making this deviation from expected behavior highly suspicious.
